newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan rupee steady as Iraqi dinar trade surges.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan rupee steady as Iraqi dinar trade surges.

text.p: The Pakistani rupee ended steady in the kerb market at 42.56 to the dollar on Wednesday amid brisk speculative trade in the Iraqi dinar ahead of an expected U.N.-Iraqi oil-for-food deal.

Dealer Salman Iqbal of ARY International Exchange said the dinar rose to 3.75 rupees at noon before falling back to close at 2.50. "Speculators are behind the rise and fall of the dinar in the Pakistani market," Iqbal said.
The central bank rate remained at 40.1200/40.3206 to the dollar. The premium on forex bearer certificates closed unchanged at 6.30 percent.
